async def use(items, operation, n):
    cap = min(1, n)
    # ruleid: serial-bounded-helper-python
    map_with_concurrency(items, operation=operation, maxConcurrency=1)
    # ruleid: serial-bounded-helper-python
    map_with_concurrency(items, operation=operation, max_concurrency=1)
    # ok: serial-bounded-helper-python
    map_with_concurrency(items, min(1, n), operation)
    # ok: serial-bounded-helper-python
    map_with_concurrency(items, min(n, 1), operation)
    # ok: serial-bounded-helper-python
    map_with_concurrency(items, cap, operation)
    map_with_concurrency(items, operation=operation, max_concurrency=4)
    map_with_concurrency(items, operation=operation, max_concurrency=n)
    map_with_concurrency(items, min(4, n), operation)
    map_with_concurrency(items, max(1, n), operation)
    map_with_concurrency(items, n + 1, operation)
    map_with_concurrency(items, min(4, n + 1), operation)
